title: Zingy Zucchini Pancakes
description: A delicious and healthy breakfast or snack recipe made with zucchini, yogurt, and pancake mix.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine grated zucchini, plain yogurt, pancake mix, egg, salt, and zingy.
Mix well to combine all ingredients.
Drop the mixture by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface, flip and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve the zucchini pancakes hot with your favorite toppings.
